steps.label: 03 / HOW WE MAKE IT HAPPEN
steps.heading: A clear path.
description: Each stage has a purpose and a review point.
Development and marketing deliverables are agreed separately.

items.title: Discover
items.description: Share your audience, goals, existing website or app, content and integration needs. We discuss priorities and responsibilities before agreeing the scope. For marketing work, this includes channels, available assets and reporting needs.

items.title: Design
items.description: Review the proposed user journeys, screens and content direction. Your feedback helps refine the agreed design before development. Marketing projects instead review the content calendar, messaging or optimization priorities relevant to the service.

items.title: Develop
items.description: Build the agreed features and review them against the requirements, including relevant device, browser and integration checks. Marketing work follows its own content or SEO scope, with reviews and approvals agreed before changes are published.

items.title: Launch & evolve
items.description: Review launch requirements, outstanding feedback and acceptance checks together. Confirm deployment, account access and handover responsibilities in the scope. Maintenance, future releases and ongoing marketing support are discussed separately from the initial delivery.
